model.cancellation_policy: none beyond TTL: no signal-based cancel, so no cancel-latency assumption enters the primary result
model.exit_rule: aggressive exit at the prevailing executable quote at fill + horizon; sell at the best bid after a buy fill, buy at the best ask after a sell fill
model.fill_model_note: fifo: a fill requires the displayed quantity ahead of us to be consumed or removed first (the conservative model). no_queue: the optimistic upper bound, in which any execution at our price level reaches us immediately, i.e. the queue-position penalty is set to zero. The two bracket the truth and are never mixed in one number.
model.fill_rule: fill only against executions (E/C) at our price level, in file order, after the displayed quantity ahead of us has been consumed or removed and real executable flow reaches our position; no fill from non-displayed trade prints; no probabilistic fills
model.order_price_rule: join the near touch: best bid for a buy, best ask for a sell
model.order_side_rule: sign(queue_imbalance); no order is submitted when imbalance == 0
model.partial_fill_rule: fill quantity is bounded by the aggressor's executed shares and by our remaining size
model.queue_ahead_rule: every displayed order resting at that price level at submission is ahead of us; nothing arriving later is
model.scope_primary: the 33 rule-conformant large-tick names of the M2-0.6 single-day proxy
model.scope_secondary: all 115 replayed names of the M2-0.6 liquidity scope
